summary: ClearSign Technologies Corp filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a follow-on public offering of 777,780 shares of common stock at $4.33 per share, with an underwriter option for an additional 116,667 shares. The offering is expected to close on June 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine equity capital raise under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3) and does not represent a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or other corporate event. The filing is a standard securities offering for general corporate purposes.
